newsitem.title: ABU DHABI: Abu Dhabi Aug air cargo volumes rise yr/yr 5.7pct.
newsitem.headline: Abu Dhabi Aug air cargo volumes rise yr/yr 5.7pct.

text.p: Abu Dhabi airport cargo volumes rose 5.7 percent in August to 5,593 tonnes from 5,290 tonnes in the same month last year, Civil Aviation Department figures show.
The airport handled 5,519 tonnes in July this year.

In August 1996, the United Arab Emirates capital's airport handled almost 2,912 tonnes of imports from a previous 2,989 tonnes. Nearly 2,682 tonnes of goods were exported in the month from 2,301 tonnes in August 1995.
These figures do not include goods in transit.
The airport handled a total of 94,032 kg of mail in the month, from a previous 73,043 kg.
Gulf Air was by far the biggest cargo operator out of Abu Dhabi in August, carrying some 1,070 tonnes in exports. The airline is owned by the governments of Abu Dhabi, Bahrain, Oman and Qatar.
